datasheet_identity.title: RC3415P P-Channel MOSFET

extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 3ff68d0c4d7db02fa9319273b6023a39f71eca4496f3c870b60c486d746a3ee1 before extraction.
The supplied four-page public datasheet is titled RC3415P P-Channel MOSFET, carries no printed revision or date, and identifies RealChip with the footer www.realchip.net.
P-channel values printed with negative signs are represented as positive magnitudes in tabulated specs; curve axes preserve the printed negative-axis semantics such as -VDS, -VGS, -ID, and -IS.
Figures 1, 2, 6, 7, and 8 contain usable target-specific electrical curves. Listed curve points are direct manual readings from visible traces and grid coordinates; no interpolated points were added.

The 125 degC RDS(on) row is retained as a separate published condition. The remaining published values such as IDSS, IGSS, gFS, switching times, Qrr, thermal resistance, maximum ratings, and SOA are not represented because the strict MOSFET extraction schema has no fields for them.
